name: Lamortmon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they have no unsuspended Digimon, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Angoramon] in their texts deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, trash the top card of their security stack.
set_name: LM-01: Limited Card Pack Digimon Ghost Game
